headline: Your Softaims waterfall journey.
subheadline: A scrollable GTMx strategy artifact for routing startups and scaleups into the right Softaims dedicated-engineers, product-squad, technical co-founder, or soft build offer. List building, campaign angles, and sample copy, prepared for Muhammed Umar.
productSummary: Softaims (thesoftaims.com / softaims.co.uk / softaims.com) is a software development and digital transformation agency — not a SaaS product. They position as technical co-founders with 0% equity stake: hire vetted senior engineers, dedicated teams, or full product builds across web, mobile, SaaS, MVP, AI/ML, cloud/DevOps, UI/UX, QA, and cyber. Homepage proof: 10+ years in market, 500+ experts / senior engineers, 230+ products delivered, $25M raised by clients, 4.5★ Trustpilot. Buyers keep IP, get timezone-aligned async support, and scale on-demand or with dedicated squads. Named industries and work patterns span FinTech, e-commerce/retail, healthcare/MedTech, logistics, SaaS, education, insurance, travel/hospitality. Muhammed Umar is Founder (contact: umar@softaims.co.uk / umar@thesoftaims.com).
coreInsight: Muhammed sells one Softaims engineering partner (vetted talent + product delivery), not a different agency per vertical. FinTech vs e-commerce vs healthcare vs SaaS is a merge tag after routing, not a second waterfall. The single routing signal is eng_product_hiring_state from LinkedIn Jobs + careers scrape: open software IC roles, open product/design/QA roles without eng ICs, open technical-leadership roles only, or none of those. That ladder maps to Softaims' live offers — dedicated engineers / staff aug, product squad delivery, technical co-founder (0% equity), then a soft remaining-TAM build playbook.

sections.label: Signal
sections.title: The signal is how the company is already staffing product and engineering
sections.takeaway: LinkedIn Jobs + careers already show open software IC roles, product/design/QA roles, technical-leadership hiring, or none of those. That eng_product_hiring_state is stronger than a title guess and cheap to collect.

sections.label: Waterfall
sections.title: One cascade routes every in-TAM startup and scaleup
sections.takeaway: First match wins. Software IC hiring first, then product/design/QA without eng ICs, then technical-leadership-only hiring, then every remaining in-TAM company Softaims sells into.

sections.label: Tiers
sections.title: Each hiring state gets a different first offer
sections.takeaway: Eng IC hiring gets a Dedicated Engineers Brief. Product/design/QA hiring gets a Product Squad Brief. Leadership-only hiring gets a Technical Co-Founder Brief. The rest get the Softaims Build Playbook.

sections.label: Campaigns
sections.title: Fill eng seats, stand up a squad, bridge the CTO gap, then cover the rest
sections.takeaway: The list is always startups and scaleups Softaims already serves. Vertical (FinTech, e-commerce, healthcare, SaaS, logistics) is a merge tag. A/Bs sit on exclusive routes (speed-to-hire vs cost / timezone vs ownership).

sections.label: Email Copy
sections.title: Copy that names the hiring state already visible on LinkedIn
sections.takeaway: Notice the open eng, product, or leadership role, poke the capacity / ship-speed / co-founder gap that state implies, then ask for a one-letter yes.

sections.label: Launch
sections.title: Launch the open eng-IC route first
sections.takeaway: Start where they already post software IC roles and still feel hiring lag vs roadmap pressure. Prove reply density, then roll product-squad, technical co-founder, and the remaining-TAM catch-all.

signalReasons: Apollo / LinkedIn Sales Nav filters on startups and scaleups (roughly seed–Series B / early growth) in FinTech, e-commerce/retail, healthcare, SaaS, logistics, education, insurance, and travel — the commercial TAM Softaims sells into. Public global TAM account count is not published on thesoftaims.com; treat size as estimated (see softaims-magnet-flags.txt) and keep each launch tier ≥~1,500 contacts where possible.

The same Jobs + careers pull returns eng_product_hiring_state: software IC roles (full-stack, backend, frontend, mobile, DevOps, AI/ML); product / design / QA roles without eng ICs; CTO / VP Engineering / Tech Lead leadership roles — enough to route without a second expensive enrichment product.

The ladder maps to live Softaims positioning (vetted dedicated engineers, product squads / MVP–SaaS builds, technical co-founders with 0% equity) plus published proof (10+ years, 500+ experts, 230+ products, $25M raised by clients, 4.5★ Trustpilot).
Buyer title (Founder / CTO / VP Eng / Head of Product) and vertical are scrape filters and merge tags, not a second waterfall. Apollo is email last after the account is routed.

sources.name: Apollo + LinkedIn Sales Nav (startup/scaleup + industry + headcount)
sources.delivers: In-TAM companies in FinTech, e-commerce, healthcare, SaaS, logistics, education, insurance, travel. The TAM spine.

sources.name: LinkedIn Jobs + careers page scrape
sources.delivers: eng_product_hiring_state: open software IC roles, product/design/QA roles, technical-leadership roles.

sources.name: Company website / careers / product page scrape
sources.delivers: Public product language, MVP/SaaS claims, and stack hints used as copy context — not a second waterfall axis.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND eng_ic_role_open = true (Full-Stack, Backend, Frontend, Mobile, Platform, DevOps, AI/ML Engineer) AND not already_customer
routingRules.why: They are already staffing engineers. Strongest intent for Softaims dedicated / staff-aug talent using published proof (500+ experts, timezone-aligned, 0% equity positioning, 230+ products).

routingRules.if: in_tam AND product_design_qa_role_open = true (Product Manager, Product Designer, UI/UX, QA) AND eng_ic_role_open = false AND not already_customer
routingRules.why: They are staffing product/design/QA without matching eng ICs — classic gap Softaims fills with a delivery squad (MVP, SaaS, mobile, integrations) rather than a body-shop lecture.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND leadership_role_open = true (CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, Tech Lead) AND no Tier 1-2 match AND not already_customer
routingRules.why: They are hiring technical leadership. Maps to Softaims 'technical co-founders with 0% equity' positioning — bridge the gap while ownership stays with the client.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND none of the above
routingRules.why: Still in TAM (startups/scaleups Softaims serves across named verticals). Softest CTA around practical build options, dedicated teams, and MVP-to-scale paths. Mandatory 100% coverage.

tiers.name: Tier 1
tiers.label: Open software IC roles
tiers.trigger: LinkedIn Jobs or careers page lists Full-Stack, Backend, Frontend, Mobile, Platform, DevOps, or AI/ML Engineer roles; not already a Softaims customer
tiers.pain: They are already trying to hire engineers and still feel slow time-to-seat, expensive local recruiting, and roadmap slip while open seats stay open.
tiers.valueProp: Dedicated Engineers Brief: Softaims as the vetted, timezone-aligned talent partner (500+ experts, A-player framing, async + sync support, 0% equity) that fills seats without bloating payroll.
tiers.dataSource: LinkedIn Jobs + careers scrape for software IC role titles
tiers.replyDensity: Highest - they already budget eng hiring
tiers.accounts: est. flagged; not published on thesoftaims.com — keep each tier ≥~1,500 contacts before launch when the TAM allows

tiers.name: Tier 2
tiers.label: Open product / design / QA roles, no eng ICs
tiers.trigger: In-TAM company posts Product Manager, Product Designer, UI/UX, or QA roles with no Tier-1 software IC roles open
tiers.pain: Product and design seats without matching eng capacity usually mean specs pile up and ship dates slip — MVP and SaaS work stalls for lack of builders.
tiers.valueProp: Product Squad Brief: Softaims delivery squad for MVP, SaaS, web, mobile, and integrations — senior engineers on contract, client owns IP, measured delivery.
tiers.dataSource: LinkedIn Jobs + careers scrape for product/design/QA titles without eng IC roles

tiers.name: Tier 3
tiers.label: Technical leadership hiring only
tiers.trigger: In-TAM company posts CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, or Tech Lead roles with no Tier 1-2 IC matches
tiers.pain: Open technical-leadership seats usually mean the founder still owns architecture and hiring debt — they need senior builders who think like CEOs and execute like CTOs while the leadership search runs.
tiers.valueProp: Technical Co-Founder Brief: Softaims 'technical co-founders with 0% equity' path — senior ownership of product and delivery without giving away the company.
tiers.dataSource: LinkedIn Jobs + careers for technical-leadership titles
tiers.replyDensity: Medium - clear ownership gap, longer sales cycle

tiers.name: Catch-all
tiers.label: Remaining in-TAM startups and scaleups
tiers.trigger: In-TAM company Softaims sells into (FinTech, e-commerce, healthcare, SaaS, logistics, education, insurance, travel / adjacent) with a Founder / CTO / VP Eng / Head of Product buyer and no Tier 1-3 eng_product_hiring_state
tiers.pain: Most early and growth teams know they need software capacity but have not posted the hire yet — so builds stall, freelancers churn, and vendors pitch templates.
tiers.valueProp: Soft Softaims Build Playbook: practical paths into dedicated engineers, MVP/SaaS builds, or a scoped squad — soft CTA, published proof (230+ products, $25M raised by clients).
tiers.dataSource: Apollo / Sales Nav after in_tam gate
tiers.accounts: est. flagged; catch-all must cover remaining TAM

campaigns.name: Eng IC hiring → dedicated engineers
campaigns.strategy: Lead with {{hiring_signal}} / {{eng_role}}, offer Dedicated Engineers Brief anchored to 500+ experts, timezone alignment, and {{case_metric}} (230+ products; clients raised $25M).
campaigns.value: Fill eng seats without bloating local payroll

campaigns.name: Product/design/QA hiring → product squad
campaigns.strategy: Lead with open {{product_role}} seats and the missing eng capacity, offer Product Squad Brief for MVP / SaaS / mobile delivery Softaims already ships.
campaigns.value: Ship the product without waiting on eng hires
campaigns.overview: Second exclusive route. Product-vs-eng gap angle.

campaigns.name: Leadership hiring → technical co-founder
campaigns.strategy: Lead with {{leadership_role}} open, offer Technical Co-Founder Brief — Softaims 0% equity technical co-founder framing while the leadership search runs.
campaigns.value: Senior product ownership without giving away equity
campaigns.overview: Third exclusive route. Co-founder / ownership angle.

campaigns.name: Remaining startups and scaleups
campaigns.strategy: Soft Softaims Build Playbook. A/B efficiency (cost / speed) vs innovation (AI / cloud / modern stack) lines — matching Charlotte's P.S. angles. Soft CTA.
campaigns.value: Simple path into Softaims talent or a scoped build

Launch Tier 1 eng-IC Dedicated Engineers Brief; hold until ≥~1,500 contacts when TAM allows, else run smaller waves with longer reply-density read.
Roll Tier 2 product/design/QA Product Squad Brief, then Tier 3 leadership-only Technical Co-Founder Brief.
Open Catch-all Softaims Build Playbook for remaining TAM.
A/B inside exclusive routes: speed-to-hire / capacity vs cost / timezone vs ownership (0% equity) framing; catch-all can A/B efficiency vs innovation (AI/cloud) per Charlotte's P.S.
